exclusions.E: The club that once owned the building now borrows the key from the headmistress, and the minutes record, without comment, that it has twice been late returning it.

WV8-P01.5.note: The narrator reports the vote and its sixty-year outcome without praise, regret or blame; the closing late-key detail has a wry edge, so amused is defensible, which makes the item not cleanly exclusive.

exclusions.A: Marrow tagged a sample of the travelers and found nine in ten alive in the tanks by spring.
exclusions.C: Kettle had offered to round up volunteers to carry mussels out in buckets, and Teo had sketched a wall of sandbags across the cove's mouth, but Prask had the tanks and the trucks.
exclusions.D: Over three days her staff lifted some thirty-five hundred mussels from the shallows and drove them to Sallow Ford, leaving a few hundred stranded in a corner too soft to reach; most of those died.
exclusions.E: The arrangement has a certain circularity.

WV8-P02.5.note: The author reports both the losses and the survival rate flatly and remarks only on the plan's circularity; the great-grandparents quip gives amused some support, so the item is not cleanly exclusive.
